ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) regions occupy the central lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips, with sparse, irregular low-intensity mottling scattered across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 65-degree V-shaped depression; however, the precise vertex and depth are occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with frequent, high-amplitude variations. Notable deep indentations and missing pixel segments are located along the distal half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular low-intensity clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) visible against the white background on both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (dark streaks) are present; specifically, four long diagonal marks on the right lobe and several shorter vertical marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across both lobes and significant missing tissue segments along the jagged trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion at the central fluke-peduncle junction caused by turbulent water spray.
